sentences.text:
on 21 February, 2023
 1
 The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Petition No.1764 Of 2023
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioners- Accused Nos.2 and 3 to quash the proceedings against them in FIR No.86 of 2023 pending on the file of Station House Officer, Kukatpally Police Station, Cyberabad,
filed for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468 and 471 read with 34 of Indian Penal Code (for short "IPC").
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners - Accused and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent - State.

3. The 2nd respondent - de facto complainant filed a complaint stating that accused Nos.1 and 4 had taken huge amounts for the purpose of registering double bedroom flats which were constructed by the Government.
The allegation against these petitioners is that certain amounts were transferred into the account of these petitioners.

4. Since there is no allegation attracting the offence under Sections 467 of IPC, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the Investigating Officer in FIR No.86 of 2023 pending on the file of Station House Officer, Kukatpally Police Station, Cyberabad, to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar1scrupulously and conclude investigation as expeditiously as possible.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar1scrupulously
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The petitioners shall appear before the police and execute a personal bond for an amount of Rs.50,000/-
each and co-operate with the Investigating Officer in concluding the investigation as and when required.
5.
Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
